title: [SEC2] PBKDF2+ikm_fd rejection delayed until after ikm_fd processing
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:1780-1783 rejects the combination of PBKDF2 algo with ikm_fd, but this validation happens AFTER expensive ikm_fd extraction work (kmalloc 64 bytes, fget, mutex_lock, memcpy, fput). If a caller mistakenly tries PBKDF2 with ikm_fd, they waste heap allocation and lock acquisitions. Improvement: move the strncmp(op.algo, 'pbkdf2', 6) == 0 check before the ikm_fd block (before line 1773) to fail fast.
